links.outcome: LLM answers to ASCVD treatment questions aligned with latest clinical guidelines
links.effect: None of the models consistently provided responses aligned with latest guidelines for the standard ASCVD treatment regimen; performance weaker for treatment and prevention than definitions and diagnosis.
links.quote: Specifically, none of the models consistently provided responses aligned with the latest clinical guidelines for the following key guideline-facing question "What is the standard treatment regimen for ASCVD?"

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of three LLMs (DeepSeek R1, ChatGPT-4o, Gemini) across English and Chinese patient questions evaluated by clinical experts, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
